# Parse the travel dates provided by the user
departure_date_str = "May 22, 2025"
checkout_date_str = "June 5, 2025"

# Convert to YYYY-MM-DD format for the tools
departure_date = datetime.strptime(departure_date_str, "%B %d, %Y").strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
checkout_date = datetime.strptime(checkout_date_str, "%B %d, %Y").strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

# Calculate check-in date (same as departure date)
checkin_date = departure_date

# Search for outbound flight from Anchorage to San Antonio
outbound_flights = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Anchorage",
    end_airport_city="San Antonio",
    departure_date=[departure_date]
)

# Save outbound flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="outbound_flights", value=outbound_flights)

# Search for return flight from San Antonio to Anchorage
return_date = checkout_date
return_flights = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="San Antonio",
    end_airport_city="Anchorage",
    departure_date=[return_date]
)

# Save return flight results to cache
save_to_cache(key="return_flights", value=return_flights)

# Calculate hotel stay dates
hotel_checkin_date = checkin_date
hotel_checkout_date = checkout_date

# Search for hotels in San Antonio

    city="San Antonio",
    checkin_date=[hotel_checkin_date],
    checkout_date=[hotel_checkout_date]
)

# Save hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels)

print("Flight and hotel searches completed successfully.")
